entries.398bb466d53d5b75: The company operates therapy services and small-scale childcare services providing physical education guidance for children with disabilities, as well as tutoring schools for infants and school-age children. It has a therapy facility, Cosmo Ryōiku Club Familia, located in Shinagawa Ward, Tokyo.
entries.424e8ba690543efa: Using the facilities of kindergartens, nursery schools and kodomo-en centers, the company runs sports clubs, soccer clubs, rhythmic gymnastics clubs and others for children ranging from kindergarten pupils to elementary school pupils who have graduated from kindergarten, and provides physical education guidance under its own curriculum.
entries.5b1c63914712d390: As part of extracurricular physical education guidance, the company plans and holds events such as soccer tournaments, excursions, training camps, winter ski and skating classes, dodgeball tournaments and rhythmic gymnastics performances. In principle, recruitment is directed at club members; parents do not participate or accompany, and the company's employees handle operations, leading and escorting.

As of March 31, 2026, the number of venues was 1,318 locations and the number of members was 66,971.
entries.942e771c430a4d12: The business provides in-class physical education guidance as part of childcare at kindergartens, nursery schools and kodomo-en centers, extracurricular physical education guidance for infants and children, therapy services providing physical education guidance for children with disabilities, and the operation of small-scale childcare services.
entries.be5f2efefed333e6: Under contracts, the company's employees visit each kindergarten, nursery school and kodomo-en center to provide direct guidance for physical education classes held during childcare hours (in-class).
entries.c0c23f454c34dc73: The business provides management guidance and operational guidance to kindergartens, nursery schools and kodomo-en centers. It offers management consulting, education consulting, operational guidance, training for facility staff, and planning of all communication activities related to early childhood education, as well as planning and production of printed materials. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥285 million, and the number of contracts was 233.
entries.c0c4308e3bbb750b: Other Businesses (Therapy and Small-Scale Childcare, etc.)
entries.d29d8e7eeae3b6ba: Under contracts, the company's employees visit each kindergarten, nursery school and kodomo-en center to provide direct guidance for physical education classes held during childcare hours (in-class). The company also provides advice on the composition of events such as athletic meets and on the formulation of a one-year curriculum. As of March 31, 2026, the number of venues where the service was provided was 1,296 facilities.
entries.f8c54002e6398cd2: A company that, centered on physical education instruction for kindergartens, nursery schools and centers for early childhood education and care, provides early childhood physical education instruction and consulting on the management of such facilities nationwide.
entries.fc912085279a06b7: The business provides in-class physical education guidance as part of childcare at kindergartens, nursery schools and kodomo-en centers, extracurricular physical education guidance for infants and children, therapy services providing physical education guidance for children with disabilities, and the operation of small-scale childcare services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,194 million.
